objective: Clothing Store Management System — Master Prompt 1: Foundation, Database, Access Control & Core Inventory
acceptance_criteria: Application installs and runs in the verified XAMPP PHP 8.2 & MySQL environment
Database migrations run successfully with strict foreign keys, unique constraints, and decimal money types
All five roles (Super Admin, Store Manager, Cashier, Warehouse Staff, Accountant) are protected by server-side authorization
Store scoping ensures Store Managers cannot access restricted data belonging to other stores
Single active session enforced; account deactivation immediately revokes sessions
Product catalog with categories, automatic concurrency-safe SKU generation (e.g. SH-000123), and no product-photo functionality
Variants with unique size/color constraints and unique Code 128 barcodes
Only Super Admin can change selling prices, retaining comprehensive price history
Barcode generation, reprinting retention, printable label templates, and camera/hardware scanning support
Stock ledger tracking all inventory movements, opening stock, warehouse receiving, and physical stock counts
Stock adjustment workflow requiring Super Admin approval before altering balances
Overselling prevention with row locking inside explicit database transactions
Audit logging for authentication, catalog, price, staff, and inventory operations without logging secrets
Bangla (bn) and English (en) localization, BDT (৳) currency, DD-MM-YYYY dates, light/dark themes
Online connectivity safeguard stopping business operations when disconnected
Comprehensive automated tests covering all 11 test suites with passing results
non_goals: Do not implement offline sales or offline transaction queues
Do not implement POS sales, receipts, or supplier accounting (deferred to Prompt 2)
